risks.risk: Country-of-origin and brand/model may be different from what’s claimed; price depends heavily on exact model and origin.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the machine’s nameplate/serial plate (including model and country-of-origin) and the motor nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used industrial/semi-industrial sewing machine with unknown model/origin.

risks.risk: “Working perfectly” is not proven; industrial machines can have timing, feed, needle bar, or clutch issues that photos can’t reveal.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the machine running under load (threaded, needle moving) and a short stitching demo on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven (worst case: needs servicing/adjustment).

risks.risk: Accessories/manual completeness is unknown; missing parts reduce value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo inventory laid out (presser feet, bobbins, tools, belts/clutch parts if any) plus the manual cover pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain accessories and manual.

risks.risk: Motor/clutch condition and electrical safety are unknown (worn clutch, weak motor, wiring faults).
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing motor start/stop and a close-up of wiring connections; also ask for a technician test note if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring basic checks (worst case: motor/clutch may need attention).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/serial plate (model + country-of-origin) and the motor nameplate.
Video of the machine running with thread and needle moving, plus a short stitching demo on fabric.
Photos showing all accessories laid out and the original manual (cover + key pages).
Close-up of belts/clutch area and wiring, plus a start/stop video.
